description: This file defines a custom exception class `BasketNotFoundException` used within the application core of the eShopOnWeb project. It is used to signal that a basket with a specified ID was not found.

classes.name: BasketNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a basket with a specific ID was not found in the system.

methods.name: BasketNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message indicating the missing basket ID.
